pairs.evidence: app/features/shared/MatchReasoningPanel.tsx:50 The only motion in this context is a short framer-motion opacity/translate crossfade and a layout height tween on the Explain-fit panel. These are small composited transitions, which per-tier-budget-tables lists as exempt from consulting a tier. A grep of app/features/shared for requestIdleCallback, hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory, requestAnimationFrame and fidelity found no capability probe, no tier and no cost-knob effect, so the subject's precondition does not hold.
